purpose: Physical AI conditional sensitivity and separately risk-adjusted FY2028 real-option layer; not a forecast or 2026E EPS input

risk_adjusted_option_valuation.valuation_horizon: FY2028 outcome, discounted two years to the 2026-07-23 valuation date
risk_adjusted_option_valuation.probability_basis: AStock house underwriting, not company guidance or consensus: product/nomination/planned-delivery evidence supports a non-zero commercialisation case, while missing named customers, actual deliveries, units, revenue, margin and cash evidence requires a majority no-conversion branch and a low platform-scale branch.

mutually_exclusive_scenarios.scenario: No measurable commercial conversion by FY2028

risk_adjusted_option_valuation.valuation_treatment: Separate real-option layer. It does not alter the 2026E base EPS, P/E anchor or reported automotive earnings bridge.

probability_policy: Numeric probabilities are permitted only as explicitly labelled AStock house underwriting in the separate real-option layer. They are scenario weights, not company guidance, consensus or evidence of current revenue; they must be reduced to zero if issuer evidence is contradicted and refreshed on G1-G3 milestones.
warnings: No customer, unit, ASP, recognised revenue, margin or cash-conversion assumption in this model is company-disclosed for Physical AI paths.
The CNY2.49 option value is a low-confidence, probability-weighted house assumption. It must be shown separately from the CNY86.4 base-business value and never represented as disclosed earnings.
P/E is a post-proof valuation assumption, not evidence of current market valuation.
